config.selection: top-5 per day, k=1, GROUND ≥ 0.01 — frozen canon, no 2026 tuning
config.scoring: G = Kelly log-growth on P_real at the smile-fit model credit; GROUND = (e^G−1)·e^(−k·D_ent)
config.fill_basis: 1.08× smile-fit model credit (19 real fills), $1.30 commission/spread; partial-WIN at 50% intrinsic
config.dkl: D_ent = D(Q_bs‖U₃) = ln3 − H(Q_bs), Q_bs = N(d2) at the smile-fit IVs (Mercurio–Wu–Xie 2020 eq. 19)
config.window: 252 sessions of realized DTE-matched moves vs the exact strikes (P_real)
config.credit_basis: smile-fit model credit (no vendor quote at the strike is used)
